questions.stem: A coin is flipped twice. Using a tree diagram, what is $P(\text{exactly one head})$?
questions.explanation: The outcomes with exactly one head are HT and TH. $P(HT) = \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{4}$ and $P(TH) = \frac{1}{4}$. Since these are mutually exclusive, $P(\text{exactly one head}) = \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{2}$.
